findings.what: The gap to a 0.955 display is tiny and depends on the base. We are 6th of 113 in the 0.954 block, so our best file (exp70b) sits ~5e-5 (range 3e-5 to 2e-4) below the ~0.9545 rounding edge. K2-based files start ~1.6e-4 below it: fm45 was worth ~+9e-5 (K2 was 16-17th of ~100 before the exp70b UP and 8th after it). A file on the exp70b base needs only ~+6e-5 on public.

findings.what: tools/runtime_ledger.py maps only exp70* to the safetail family, so exp72/exp73*/exp74/exp75/exp76* read as 'family unknown' (no R5(a), no insertion-gate text).
